answer: Every payout sits in a lagoon for one cooling epoch, and each extra identity funded through the same source lengthens that wait while multiplying its escrow: the j-th sibling locks j squared, so n heads tie up n cubed over three. Reopening a lagoon burns ember, and the burn is audited by a lotus, a bloom only a genuinely fresh context can produce; blooms whose styles cluster are merged into one, and the merged payout is split across every head in it. A farm thus needs separate contexts it cannot pool, waits longer per head, and divides a shrinking share, so scaling buys delay instead of yield.
